catalogue.name: ChEMBL bioactivity records, human Adenosine A1 receptor (ADORA1)
catalogue.license: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported (CC BY-SA 3.0), ChEMBL data licence
catalogue.format: REST JSON (same endpoint serves .csv and .tsv via Accept/format parameter)

subjects.target: Adenosine receptor A1, Homo sapiens, SINGLE PROTEIN (CHEMBL226)

constrains.frozen_label: assumption, paired by construction to the Briddon 2004 Kd anchor
constrains.unit_transformation: nM as retrieved; uM multiplied by 1000, pM divided by 1000
constrains.what_it_gives: an independent measured distribution of equilibrium dissociation constants for the same receptor family as the frozen 33 nM anchor, i.e. a bracket, not a fit
constrains.strength: direct for Kd; none for kon and koff separately

catalogue.name: ChEMBL bioactivity records, human Beta-2 adrenergic receptor (ADRB2)
catalogue.license: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported (CC BY-SA 3.0), ChEMBL data licence

subjects.target: Beta-2 adrenergic receptor, Homo sapiens, SINGLE PROTEIN (CHEMBL210)

constrains.frozen_parameter: D_R = 0.04 um^2/s anchor provenance and the kon/koff pair

catalogue.name: ChEMBL kinetics subset for ADORA1 (Kon / Koff only)
catalogue.value_unit: as retrieved: 2 records, standard_type Koff, standard_units '1/nM.1/min'

constrains.frozen_parameter: kon_s1_nM1 = 0.02 s^-1 nM^-1 and koff_s1 = 0.66 s^-1
constrains.unit_transformation: NOT APPLIED - the retrieved unit is a ChEMBL composite rate unit, not s^-1 or s^-1 nM^-1; converting it to the model's kon/koff would be an invention
constrains.what_it_gives: evidence that measured single-receptor kon/koff in the model's own units is essentially absent from this source for the anchor receptor

catalogue.name: RCSB PDB 3SN6 - beta2 adrenergic receptor / Gs / VHH ternary crystal structure
catalogue.license: CC0 1.0 Universal (wwPDB data are in the public domain)
catalogue.format: mmCIF (PDBx/mmCIF), also available as legacy PDB and BCIF
catalogue.value_unit: angstrom (the _atom_site.length_unit header field is absent in this entry; the mmCIF default is applied and the coordinates are consistent with the 48.8/65.4/84.6 A cell reported in _cell)

coordinate_frame.frame: deposited crystallographic asymmetric unit of the P 1 21 1 cell, right-handed Cartesian
coordinate_frame.axes: _atom_site.Cartn_x / Cartn_y / Cartn_z, origin at the deposited cell origin, not at the receptor
coordinate_frame.caveat: this is a CRYSTAL frame, not a membrane frame. The xy projection used below is a projection in the crystal frame and is NOT the plane of the bilayer. Any statement about membrane packing is therefore an upper-bound argument, not a measurement of a membrane.

subjects.title: Crystal structure of the beta2 adrenergic receptor-Gs protein complex

chain_entity_map.A: Guanine nucleotide-binding protein G(s) subunit alpha isoforms short
chain_entity_map.B: Guanine nucleotide-binding protein G(I)/G(S)/G(T) subunit beta-1
chain_entity_map.G: Guanine nucleotide-binding protein G(I)/G(S)/G(O) subunit gamma-2

constrains.recorded_field: _atom_site.Cartn_x/y/z of the C-alpha atoms of auth_asym_id R (Endolysin,Beta-2 adrenergic receptor)
constrains.unit_transformation: angstrom -> nm by x 0.1; convex hull of the C-alpha xy projection in nm^2
constrains.what_it_gives: the size of one receptor: it bounds a single-receptor patch from below, so a 300 nm Gaussian patch spans tens of receptor diameters, i.e. the frozen 'patch' is a many-receptor aggregate, not a receptor
constrains.strength: direct and quantitative for receptor size; only an indirect bound for the patch parameter

constrains.recorded_field: same C-alpha cloud, projected hull area
constrains.what_it_gives: implied_max_areal_packing_receptor_per_um2 = 42120.16, the density at which receptor-sized objects would tile the plane with no gap. The frozen 55 receptor/um^2 is 0.13 % of that.
constrains.strength: a physical ceiling, not a measurement of an occupied membrane; a sparse membrane is entirely consistent with it

catalogue.name: Human Protein Atlas proteinatlas.tsv (per-gene summary table, 20162 genes x 119 columns)
catalogue.license: CC0 1.0 Universal (Human Protein Atlas data are released under CC0)
catalogue.format: zipped tab-separated values, one row per gene
catalogue.value_unit: per-column, carried in the column name (nTPM / pTPM / nCPM / NX); NOT convertible to receptor/um^2

constrains.unit_transformation: NONE APPLIED. The retrieved file carries no per-tissue expression value columns for these genes, so no cohort spread can be computed. RNA abundance in nTPM is in any case not a surface density in receptor/um^2.
constrains.what_it_gives: presence of ADORA1 and ADRB2 as protein-coding genes in a human reference proteome cohort; nothing quantitative for the frozen density
constrains.strength: none for T1 as retrieved - recorded as a partial result, not a constraint
